# Project state Kept up to date by each task: what was done, important decisions, known gaps. ## p1-setup — Project skeleton: Vite + Preact + TypeScript + Vitest - Created `web/` as a real npm project: `package.json` (preact ^11.2, idb ^8.0, dev deps @preact/preset-vite ^2.10, typescript ^7.0, vite ^8.3, vitest ^5.1.1, fake-indexeddb ^6.2.8 — current versions at the time), `tsconfig.json`, `vite.config.ts` (preact plugin + vitest `test.environment: 'node'`), `index.html`. - `web/src/styles.css` copied byte-identical from `.orys/sketch/code/web/src/styles.css` — later UI tasks must keep reusing its classes/tokens, not restyle. - `web/src/main.tsx` renders a minimal placeholder (`.wrap` + `

Habits

`); a later task (p1-today-screen) replaces it with the real screen. - `web/src/lib/smoke.test.ts` is a trivial passing test so `npm test` has something to run; replace/extend alongside real logic in p1-dates etc. - Did not copy `src/seed.ts`, `src/core.ts`, `src/ui.tsx` or `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` from the sketch — those are for later tasks (p1-dates, p1-today-screen) to port properly, not for this task. - Root `.gitignore` already ignored `node_modules/` and `dist/` at any depth, so `web/node_modules` and `web/dist` are covered without changes. A stray pre-existing `web/dist/` (from an earlier sketch build, not tracked by git) was removed before building fresh. - All four gate commands pass: `npm install`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` (emits `web/dist/index.html`). - Known gap (expected): no app logic yet — habits, streaks, IndexedDB, the Today screen all come in later tasks per `docs/PLAN.md`. ## p1-dates — Date, streak and calendar logic with unit tests - Added `web/src/lib/dates.ts`: the only module that touches `Date`. `DayKey` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `keyOf`, `dateOf`, `addDays`, `diffDays`, `todayKey`, `lastNDays`, `heatmapWeeks`, `MONTH_SHORT`, `WEEKDAY_SHORT`. Ported from `.orys/sketch/code/web/src/core.ts` and hardened: `diffDays` rounds the ms difference between two local midnights (needed because a DST transition between them makes the raw difference not an exact multiple of a day). - Added `web/src/lib/streaks.ts`: `streaks(done, today)` → `{ current, longest }`, same semantics as the sketch (an unticked today still counts yesterday's run; longest is the best run anywhere in the set). Pure — takes `today` as a parameter, never reads the clock. - Tests: `web/src/lib/dates.test.ts` and `web/src/lib/streaks.test.ts`, 31 tests total, covering leap years, year/month boundaries, EU and US DST transitions (via temporarily setting `process.env.TZ` and restoring it in `afterEach`), a 400-day no-repeat walk across four time zones, and the streak edge cases from the task spec (empty, single day, open-today, longest-in-the-past, Feb 29). - **Decision for later tasks**: `streaks.ts` imports `addDays` from `dates.ts` — keep `dates.ts` as the single source of day arithmetic; do not reimplement date math in `db.ts`, `state.ts` or the UI. - Added `@types/node` as a dev dependency and `"node"` to `tsconfig.json`'s `types` array, needed because the DST tests read/write `process.env.TZ`. This is a shared config file — later tasks don't need to touch it again for this reason. - Did not touch `web/src/lib/smoke.test.ts`, `main.tsx`, or anything from p1-setup beyond `package.json`/`tsconfig.json` as above. - Known gap (expected): nothing yet reads `today` from the real clock in the app (that's `state.ts` in `p1-state`); no IndexedDB, no UI changes in this task. ## p1-store — IndexedDB store for habits and ticks - Added `web/src/lib/types.ts` (`Habit`, `Tick`) and `web/src/lib/db.ts`, the only module that imports `idb`. Database `habits` v1 with `habits` (keyPath `id`) and `ticks` (keyPath `id`, indexes `by-habit` on `habitId` and `by-day` on `day`) object stores, per spec. - `openDb()` memoises the `openDB(...)` call in a module-level promise so repeated calls share one connection. - `deleteHabit` and `replaceAll` each do their multi-store writes in one `readwrite` transaction, as required. - `web/src/lib/db.test.ts` uses `fake-indexeddb/auto` and covers all the acceptance criteria (idempotent `setTick`, `deleteHabit` isolation between habits, `reorderHabits`, `replaceAll` including the empty case). Because `openDb()` memoises the connection, each test closes the previous connection, `indexedDB.deleteDatabase('habits')`, then `vi.resetModules()` + re-imports `./db` to get a clean module instance — `indexedDB.deleteDatabase` otherwise hangs waiting for the prior connection to close. - `deleteHabit` has no caller yet (archiving goes through `setArchived`/`putHabit` on a later task) — kept per the task's instruction to keep it for future use; flagging per the reviewer note in case it should be trimmed. - All three gate commands pass (`npm install`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test -- src/lib/db.test.ts`); full `npm test` (40 tests) also passes. ## p1-state — App state hook: load once, tick instantly, write through - Added `web/src/state.ts` exporting `useHabitStore()` (Preact hook, `preact/hooks`) plus three pure helpers also used directly by `state.test.ts`: `buildTickMap`, `toggleInMap`, `isEditableDay`. - On first mount with an empty database, creates the three starter habits ('Morning run' `#f97362`, 'Read 20 pages' `#5b9cf6`, 'Meditate' `#8b7bf0`) via `createHabit` — checked by `listHabits().length === 0`, so it never reseeds on later loads. Deliberately did not port `.orys/sketch/code/web/src/seed.ts`'s 200-day fake history. - `toggle(habitId, day)` updates the in-memory `ticks` map synchronously (optimistic), then calls `setTick`; on rejection it re-toggles the same entry to roll back (toggling twice is a no-op, per the `toggleInMap` round-trip property proved in tests). Days outside `[today-6, today]` are rejected via `isEditableDay` before touching state or the database. - `selectedHabitId` persists to `localStorage['habits.selectedHabit']`, restored on load and falling back to the first active habit by `order`; `catchUpDay` defaults to yesterday and is re-clamped into the editable window whenever `today` changes. - `today` is seeded once via `todayKey()` on mount and recomputed on `visibilitychange` so a tab left open past midnight picks up the new day. - `renameHabit`, `recolorHabit`, `setArchived`, `reorder`, `addHabit` all update React/Preact state first, then write through `db.ts` (`putHabit`/`reorderHabits`/`createHabit`); no new functions were added to `db.ts` for this task. - `web/src/state.test.ts` covers the pure-helper acceptance criteria only (no DOM/jsdom needed): map round-trip, non-mutating toggle, toggle-twice-is-identity, and `isEditableDay`'s boundary days. The hook's effectful behaviour (mount loading, visibility handling, rollback) is exercised by `p1-today-screen`'s component tests, not here. - Known gap (expected, per `docs/PLAN.md`): nothing calls `useHabitStore()` yet — `main.tsx` still renders the `p1-setup` placeholder; wiring it into the real Today screen is `p1-today-screen`. - Confirmed nothing outside `web/src/lib/db.ts` imports `idb`, and nothing references the sketch's `seed.ts`. - Both gate commands pass (`npm run typecheck`, `npm test -- src/state.test.ts`); full `npm test` (45 tests) also passes. ## p1-today-screen — Today screen as sketch v1, with seven-day check-in - Ported `Tick`/`Check`, `Heat`, `Legend`, `prettyToday` from `.orys/sketch/code/web/src/ui.tsx` into `web/src/components/` (one file each); dropped `Switcher` and the unused `hues` helper. `Tick` changed from a plain `` to a real `
